modern: Look within. Within is the fountain of good, and it will always bubble up, if you will always dig.
original: Look within. Within is the fountain of good, and it will ever bubble up, if thou wilt ever dig.

explained.summary: Look inward. The source of goodness is inside you, and it will keep flowing as long as you keep digging. Marcus means that goodness isn’t found in outside things; it’s something you draw up from your own mind by continual effort.
